modifications: Converted from TEI XML to plain text paragraphs with emphasis, with the long s printed as s. On chapters 1 to 3 each lecture is one section, keyed by the label of the passage it quotes, such as HOSEA 2. 6. 7. or HOSEA 1. the middle of the 11. verse, and never by the lecture's number; a lecture whose label names its verse only in words, such as the middle of the second verse, continues the section before it, and lectures that open on the same verse share its section. On chapters 4 to 13 each exposition the transcription divides off is one section, keyed by the verse the transcription numbers it with, and the exposition of Hosea 8:14, printed inside that of 8:13, stays with it. A section runs from its own verse to the verse before the next section or the end of its chapter. Burroughs's lectures end at Hosea 13:11, so the last section ends there, and the notes he prepared for another sermon on that verse stay with it. A verse named in the exposition is never read. Every gap the transcribers could not key is kept as the mark they gave it, such as • for an illegible letter and 〈◊〉 for an illegible word. Line-end hyphens are closed up. Left out: the title pages, the frontispiece, the epistles to the reader, the imprimatur, the publishers' lists of books, the tables of contents, the alphabetical tables, the supervisor's epistle to the reader, and the chapter headings such as HOSEA, CHAP. 2. or CHAP. VIII.
